summary: 研究者把社交机器人 QRIO 放进托幼班，观察幼儿是否会持续与它互动。孩子逐渐表现出照料行为，但机器人能否自主回应，以及童年陪伴的长期影响，仍有待检验。
logic: 托幼班改变机器人行为
讨论自主性及长期影响

paragraphs.brief: 发展机器人，在社会上与人们互动，在日常生活中帮助他们，是现代科学的一个难以实现的目标。
sentences: The development of robots that interact socially with people and assist them in everyday life has been an elusive goal of modern science.
发展机器人，在社会上与人们互动，在日常生活中帮助他们，是现代科学的一个难以实现的目标。
Despite impressive advances in the mechanical aspects of this problem, producing robots that bond and socialize with people for sustained periods of time has proven difficult.
尽管这个问题的机械方面取得了令人印象深刻的进展，但生产出与人长期联系和社交的机器人证明是困难的。

The most successful robots so far have been storytellers, but they have only been able to maintain human interest for a limited time and typically rely on the robot telling stories that change over time.
迄今最成功的机器人是讲故事的人，但他们只能维持人类的兴趣一段时间，并且通常依靠机器人讲述故事随着时间的推移而变化。
In practice, commercially available robots seldom cross the 10-hour barrier (i.e., individual users tend to spend less than a combined total of 10 hours with the robots before losing interest).
实际上，商业上可用的机器人很少跨越10小时的屏障(即个人用户往往在失去利息之前与机器人共花费不到10小时)。
This observation is in sharp contrast to the long-term interactions and bonding that commonly develop between humans and their pets.
这一看法与人类及其宠物之间通常形成的长期相互作用和联系形成鲜明对比。

paragraphs.brief: 在最近的一项研究中，加利福尼亚神经计算研究所的研究人员将最先进的社会机器人引入一个18至24个月大的教室，为期5个月，作为研究人类/机器人相互作用的一种方法。
sentences: In a recent study, researchers from the Institute for Neural Computation in California introduced a state-of-the-art social robot into a classroom of 18-to-24-month-olds for five months as a way of studying human/robot interactions.
在最近的一项研究中，加利福尼亚神经计算研究所的研究人员将最先进的社会机器人引入一个18至24个月大的教室，为期5个月，作为研究人类/机器人相互作用的一种方法。
The researchers, including Fumihide Tanaka and Javier R. Movellan, introduced a toddler-sized humanoid robot into a classroom at a childhood education center.
研究人员，包括Fumihide Tanaka和Javier R. Mollan，将一个幼儿大小的人类机器人引入了儿童教育中心的教室。
One of the QRIO series of robots, the 58 cm machine, was originally developed by Sony.
QRIO系列的机器人之一，58厘米的机器，最初由索尼开发。
‘Children of toddler age were chosen because they have no preconceived notions of robots,’ according to Tanaka.
Tanaka认为，" 幼儿是因为他们对机器人没有先入为主的概念而选择的。
One of the goals of the study was to establish whether it was possible for social robots to maintain the interest of children beyond the 10-hour barrier.
研究的目标之一是确定社会机器人能否在10小时屏障之外维护儿童的利益。

paragraphs.brief: 最后，在机器人被指示展示其全部行为之后，人类与机器人的关系在过去三次会议上有所改善。
sentences: The researchers sent instructions to the robot about every two minutes to do things like giggle, dance, sit down, fall down, or walk in a certain direction.
研究人员每两分钟向机器人发出指令来做一些事情比如笑笑、跳舞、坐下、跌倒或向某个方向走
The 45 sessions were videotaped, and interactions between toddlers and the robot were later analyzed.
45个课程被录像，后来分析了幼儿和机器人之间的相互作用。
The results showed that the quality of those interactions improved steadily over 27 sessions.
结果表明，在27届会议期间，这些互动的质量稳步提高。
The interactions deteriorated quickly over the next 15 sessions, when the robot was ordered to behave in a more limited, predictable manner.
在接下来的15场比赛中，相互作用迅速恶化，当时，机器人被命令以更有限、更可预测的方式行事。
Finally, the human/robot relations improved in the last three sessions, after the robot had been instructed to display its full range of behaviors.
最后，在机器人被指示展示其全部行为之后，人类与机器人的关系在过去三次会议上有所改善。

paragraphs.brief: 田中说，“最初，孩子们对待机器人的方式与对待机器人的方式非常不同。
sentences: ‘Initially, the children treated the robot very differently from the way they treated each other,’ Tanaka said.
田中说，“最初，孩子们对待机器人的方式与对待机器人的方式非常不同。
‘Early in the study, some children cried when QRIO fell.
“在研究中，有些儿童在QRIO倒塌时哭泣。
But a month into the study, the toddlers helped QRIO stand up by pushing its back or pulling its hands.’
但是，在研究的一个月里，学童们帮助QRIO挺身而出，推倒或拉动了它的手。
‘The most important aspect of interaction was touch,’ Tanaka said.
Tanaka说，“互动的最重要方面是触摸。
‘At first, the toddlers would touch the robot on its face, but later on they would touch it only on its hands and arms, like they would with other humans.
首先，幼童们会碰机器人的脸，但后来，他们只碰它的手和手臂，犹如他们碰其他人类一样。
Another robot-like toy named Robby, which resembled QRIO but did not move, was used as a control in the study.
另一个机器人般的玩具Robby，与QRIO相似，但没有移动，被用作研究中的控制器。
While hugging of QRIO increased, hugging of Robby decreased throughout the study.
在整个研究过程中，对QRIO的拥抱增加，对Robby的拥抱减少。
Furthermore, when QRIO laid down on the floor, caretaking behaviors were frequently observed toward QRIO but seldom toward Robby.’
此外，当QRIO趴在地上时，人们经常看到对QRIO的照顾行为，但很少见到Robby。

paragraphs.brief: 研究结论是，在儿童照料中心沉浸了45天之后，幼儿与最先进的社会机器人之间出现了长期的联系和社会化。
sentences: The study concluded that after 45 days of immersion in a childcare center over a period of five months, long-term bonding and socialization occurred between toddlers and a state-of-the-art social robot.
研究结论是，在儿童照料中心沉浸了45天之后，幼儿与最先进的社会机器人之间出现了长期的联系和社会化。
Overall, the interaction between children and the robot improved over time and the children progressively treated it more as a peer than a plaything.
总的来说，儿童与机器人之间的相互作用随着时间的推移有所改善，儿童们逐渐把它当作一种同伴而不是玩物来对待。
‘To my knowledge, this is the first long-term study of this sort,’ said Ronald Arkin, a roboticist at the Georgia Institute of Technology in the US.
Ronald Arkin，美国佐治亚理工学院的机器人学家：“据我所知，这是第一次长期研究这类。”

paragraphs.brief: Tanaka和Mollan现在在为幼儿教室开发自主机器人。
sentences: Tanaka and Movellan are now developing autonomous robots for the toddler classroom.
Tanaka和Mollan现在在为幼儿教室开发自主机器人。
‘It could have great potential in educational settings, assisting teachers and enriching the classroom environment,’ Tanaka said.
Tanaka说：「帮助教师：“它在教育环境中具有巨大潜力。”
The researchers hope that more advanced versions of robots like QRIO could become personalized tutors to assist teachers in classrooms.
研究人员希望更先进的机器人版本，如QRIO，能够成为个性化的导师，以协助教室教师。
A robotic tutor could react on the spot to social cues and approximate social skills like facial expression and eye gaze, they said.
他们说：“机器人导师可以当场对社交提示和近似社交技能，如面部表情和眼神反应。”
‘It is becoming clear that, to achieve this goal, we are going to endow machines with something similar to emotion, not just traditional forms of intelligence,’ said Movellan.
不只是传统的智力形式，" 说，莫林：“越来越清楚的是，为了实现这一目标，我们将用与情感相似的东西来给机器施压。”

paragraphs.brief: 罗纳德·阿金对幼童对机器人的爱意并不感到惊讶。
sentences: Associate Professor David Powers, an expert in artificial intelligence and cognitive science at Flinders University in South Australia, commented, ‘In this study, it is clearly demonstrated that a limited range of robot behaviors, however impressive, is nowhere near as important to human/robot interaction as being able to make appropriate responses from a broad repertoire of behaviors.’
南澳大利亚Flinders大学人工智能和认知科学专家David Powers副教授评论说：“ 在这次研究中，可以清楚地看到，有限范围的机器人行为，无论多么令人印象深刻，对于人类/机器人的相互作用来说，远比不上能够从广泛的一系列行为中作出适当反应。”
Ronald Arkin was not surprised by the affection demonstrated by the toddlers toward the robot.
罗纳德·阿金对幼童对机器人的爱意并不感到惊讶。
‘Humans have a tremendous propensity to bond with artifacts, whether it be a car, a doll, or a robot,’ he said.
不管是汽车，娃娃，还是机器人，'他说：“人类有巨大的倾向与文物联系。”
But he also cautioned that researchers do not yet understand the consequences of increased human/robot interaction.
但他也告诫说，研究人员还不了解人类/机器人互动增加的后果。
‘Studying how robots and humans work together can give us insight into whether this is a good thing or a bad thing for society,’ Arkin said.
阿金说：“研究机器人和人类如何一起工作能够让我们深入了解这对社会是好事还是坏事。”
‘We need to find out what the consequences are of introducing a robot into a cadre of children.
我们需要弄清楚把机器人引进一个儿童骨干会有什么后果。
How will that enhance, or potentially interfere with, their social development?
这将如何促进或可能妨碍他们的社会发展？
Do we really understand the long-term impact of having a robot as a childhood friend?’
我们真的理解机器人作为童年朋友的长期影响吗？”

items.en: a comparison of children’s reactions towards different robots
items.zh: 儿童对不同机器人的反应比较
items.why: 题干关键词是 comparison / different robots。第D段把 QRIO vs Robby 放在同一句里对比 (拥抱趋势相反),并补充“caretaking behaviours…toward QRIO but seldom toward Robby”,属于明确的“不同机器人反应对比"。

items.en: a speculation about ways robots may be able to communicate
items.zh: 一个关于机器人可以沟通的方式的猜测
items.why: 题干是 speculation (推测、展望未来)。第F段 i& “could…/ hope…/ become…”: 机器人未来可通过 facial expression / eye gaze 等社交信号与人互动，本质是“沟通方式的推测”。

items.en: a description of changes in the way the children physically handled a robot
items.zh: 描述孩子身体处理机器人的方式的变化
items.why: 幼儿起初会摸机器人的脸，后来像对人一样只触碰它的手和胳膊，体现互动动作的变化。

items.en: a comparison between people’s connections with animals and their connections with robots
items.zh: 比较人类与动物的关系和它们与机器人的关系
items.why: 题干要 robots vs animals 的比较。第A 段先说机器人难以维持长期兴趣 (10-hour barrier),紧接着用 contrast 对比人和宠物的长期bonding,完全匹配。

items.en: an account of the way one robot was programmed
items.zh: 一个机器人编程的方式
items.why: 题干关键词 programmed / account of the way。第C段描述具体控制方式: 研究者频繁发送指令、不同阶段命令其表现“limited/ predictable”或“full range of behaviors”,这是最直接的“编程/控制过程打述”。

items.en: In future, robots will not only have to think, but also to show feelings.
items.zh: 将来，机器人不仅必须思考，而且还要展现感情。

items.en: It is uncertain whether more contact between people and robots will be beneficial.
items.zh: 人与机器人之间的更多接触是否有益尚不确定。

items.en: Very young children have not yet developed ideas about robots.
items.zh: 幼小的孩子还没有开发出关于机器人的想法。

items.en: Robots need to perform a wide variety of actions for people to relate to them.
items.zh: 机器人需要执行各种各样的行动以便人们与他们有关。

items.en: Using robots as an aid in schools may have many benefits.
items.zh: 在学校使用机器人作为辅助可能有许多好处。

items.en: Until recently, robots that were best at holding people’s attention were those that acted as ________
items.zh: 直到不久前，最能持续吸引人们注意的机器人，是那些充当________的机器人。
items.why: 题干“acted as…” 对应原文“have been…”, 且要求一个词，原文复数 storytellers 完全匹配语法。

items.en: The children responded to the QRIO robot as a friend or a ________rather than as a toy.
items.zh: 孩子们把 QRIO 机器人当作朋友或________，而非玩具。
items.why: 空格前是“a”,后面是“rather than…toy”,原文对比结构 peer vs plaything,且答案必须来自原文并为一个词: peer。

items.en: Arkin expected that the children would show ________towards the QRIO robot.
items.zh: 阿金原本预计，孩子们会对 QRIO 机器人表现出________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“罗纳德·阿金对幼童对机器人的爱意并不感到惊讶”，再按题干要求写出答案。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: 尚未形成先入为主的观点
points: 题干关键词 programmed / account of the way。第C段描述具体控制方式: 研究者频繁发送指令、不同阶段命令其表现“limited/ predictable”或“full range of behaviors”,这是最直接的“编程/控制过程打述”。
回到对应内容“罗纳德·阿金对幼童对机器人的爱意并不感到惊讶”，再按题干要求写出答案。
clauses: The development of robots … has been an elusive goal of modern science.
“that interact socially with people and assist them in everyday life”修饰前面的 development。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 development，再把修饰信息接回主句。
‘Children of toddler age were chosen …,’ according to Tanaka.
连接词 because 引出“because they have no preconceived notions of robots”，说明主句的原因关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 because 把这一层关系补进去。
vocabulary: 长时间置身于某种环境
